scenes.vo: So I dropped them into SaveSort to see which AI hustles are real.

scenes.label: TAP AI & TOOLS
scenes.vo: Tap AI and tools. 33 saves. Let's check four of them.

scenes.quote: Build an AI receptionist and sell it to local businesses
scenes.vo: AI receptionist? Real. Tools like Vapi run about 30 cents a minute all in. Test it hard before you sell it.

scenes.quote: A free AI agent that finds you clients
scenes.vo: A free AI that finds clients? Real and open source. It runs on Claude Pro, 20 dollars a month. You approve every email.

scenes.quote: Build any app with one prompt
scenes.vo: Any app in one prompt? Half true. Lovable's free plan gives you 5 credits a day. Big apps eat them fast.
100 agents at once? You'll hit your limit before lunch. 3 to 5 is the useful number.
Two real, two hype. Still not rich. But now I know where to start.
